programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Fall | E01
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. It's fall in Canada, and the cold winter will soon begin. The animals have little time: they must make the most of the available food before it disappears under the deep snow and ice. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – Perfect Predator | S01E01
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. As a result of evolution, sharks have become natural hunters, perfect predators. They are extremely effective in chasing their prey in open waters and hunting from ambush. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Boo-Yah: A Portrait of Stuart Scott
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys: The Fires of Pele (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, JAV, 2015. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: Kanada, JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep4 «Volcanic Odysseys»…The number one tourist attraction on the island of Hawaii is a volcano called Kilauea. After a sudden collapse of the crater floor, a massive eruption drains the volcano of lava and now Kilauea is silent. Geologist Phillip Ong finally has his chance to explore | There are few forces on earth that equal the power and destructive force of a volcano. Their impact has helped shape this planet, altered climates, and laid waste to entire civilizations. That destructive power has terrified, awed and fascinated humans for centuries. However for those who understand them, they are beautiful spectacles of the earth's inner mechanism at work. Out of the approximately 550 active volcanoes on the planet, few are ever destructive. They remain content to put on a spectacle for all those near, or increasing numbers of adventurers who dare to venture to remote locations to watch one of natures most incredible shows. Where there is a demand, there is opportunity, A small German based company Volcano Discovery is cashing in on what has become a new craze, and catering to the adventurous and volcano curious Volcanologist Thomas Pfeiffer, and his team of local experts, take guests on exciting journeys around the world to the most eruptive volcanoes. From the notorious and deadly Krakatoa, to the remote and inhospitable heat of the Danakill Depression of Ethiopia, Volcanic Odysseys follows Thomas and his crew as they l take viewers into world of beauty and awe of this somewhat misunderstood spectacle | Director: Michael Dalton-Smith

programme.title: Life's Journey: Life's Lessons (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep2 «Life's Journey»…If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased – but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death | With stunning fotage from the wilds of Africa, this three-part documentary series examines how the indigenous creatures of this fascinating continent deal with risk and danger when thay are at their most vulnerable and susceptible to attack. The show begins with how the parents of newborn animals defend them against the unwelcome attentions of predators when their young are expereincing the frightening realities of life for the very first time. As the offspring grow older, their place in the world is still uncertain with many obstacles to overcome before they reach the relative safety of adulthood. The final epsiode looks at the crucial mating rituals which ensure the survival of the species | Director: Hannah Hoare, Matthew Thompson | Cast: Gillian Burke

programme.title: In the animal world. 43 p.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: Wild Japan – land of a thousand islands
programme.desc:
Japan, with its four main islands and over 6,000 mostly uninhabited islets, stretches over 3,000 kilometers from the Sea of ​​Okhotsk to the Philippine Sea. Flora and fauna fascinate. 

On Honshu, the largest island, there is both urban areas and wilderness. At the temple complex, with the world's largest bronze Buddha statue, in the former capital Nara, wild sika deer are the attraction. The Japanese worship them as messengers of the gods. In addition, every year the impressive cherry tree blossoms in spring attract tourists from all over the world.

Macaques are also increasingly venturing out of the hinterland to find more convenient sources of food. For example, the curious monkeys bathe in hot thermal springs. The spectacle attracts many tourists, who in turn throw small treats into the water for the macaques. Only when the monkeys are full do they retreat into the wild in the evening.

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: It is not a river in the classic sense, but rather a gigantic river system. With its tens of thousands of tributaries, the Amazon transports a fifth of the earth's total fresh water supply and, with an average depth of 30 to 40 meters, is navigable for ocean-going ships over 3,500 kilometers inland. \n\nThe first program in a three-part BBC series focuses on the enormous biodiversity in this complex and only rudimentarily researched ecosystem. Only a few years ago, for example, a boiling hot watercourse was discovered in the middle of the jungle, which the Spanish conquerors had already reported about. Woe betide anyone who accidentally goes swimming there...

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: He gave rise to one of humanity's first advanced civilizations in Egypt and competes with the Amazon for the position of the longest watercourse on earth. But the Nile is also an extremely fragile lifeline that, if thrown out of balance, can even dry up completely. Like 17,000 years ago, when the river almost dried up. \n\nThe trigger was, of all things, icebergs breaking off in the Arctic, which released so much fresh water into the Atlantic that ocean currents were disrupted. The result: less heat was removed from the Atlantic, westerly winds and the associated monsoon precipitation did not occur - the Nile almost dried up. A process that could repeat itself.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này mang đến những lực lượng đặc biệt tốt nhất từ ​​Iron Squad để thực hiện một thử thách mới - Dodgeball. 26 người chơi sẽ tham gia một cuộc thi khốc liệt, cho đến khi một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao mạnh mẽ và sức mạnh tinh thần được hình thành. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRÒ CHƠI ĐOẠT MẠNG - ELIMINATION GAME
programme.desc: Hải quân SEAL Rick bị kết án thối rữa trong một nhà tù quân sự cho đến khi anh ta được trao cơ hội để đưa cuộc sống của mình lên hàng và giành được tự do của mình trong một chương trình giết người hoặc bị giết. Rick sẽ phải loại bỏ một số kẻ giết người khét tiếng nhất thế giới trên truyền hình trực tiếp để có được sự tự do và xóa tên của anh ta. Cuối cùng anh ấy có thể thành công không?

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ lính nữ ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị lực lượng đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thách thức trên khắp đất liền, biển và không khí. Những người bảo vệ nữ hàng đầu tạo thành các đội bốn người để cạnh tranh với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cuối cùng trước sáu chủ nhà nổi tiếng!

programme.title: NA TRA: ĐƯỜNG ĐUA RỰC LỬA - NEZHA
programme.desc: Một cựu tay đua đội bóng hàng đầu muốn chứng tỏ bản thân trong một cuộc đua nhưng vô tình làm tổn thương đồng đội Lily của mình, dẫn đến sự sụp đổ của đội. Khi một nhà vô địch đua xe ảo thiếu kinh nghiệm gia nhập đội bóng và bất ngờ tỏa sáng trong một cuộc đua thực tế, ba người lái xe có thể hợp tác để lấy lại vinh quang cho đội của họ không?

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình đưa các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào vòng đấm bốc của người nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu nữ đầu tiên của người Thái và mùa 3 có hai huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh cho chức vô địch. Chương trình quyền anh độc đáo này cung cấp giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận đánh thực sự với máu!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có bốn người nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Tham gia với các người mẫu nổi tiếng của Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên đá quý ẩn giấu của thành phố, đắm mình trong những sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm hợp thời trang.
